html.body: Date: 2025-04-07 REMARKSI. Introduction Claims 1, 3-15 and 17-20 are pending. The amendments are made without disclaimer of subject matter, and the Applicant reserves the right to pursue subject matter of any previously pending claim in a continuation or divisional application. No new matter has been introduced. The Applicant requests reconsideration in light of the amendment to the claims and the following remarks.II. Rejection under 35 U.S.C. § 103 Claim(s) 1, 4 - 5, 11, 15, 18 and 20 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Ha in view of Rinke et al. (US Pub No: 2022/0184802 Al, hereinafter "Rinke") and Huang (CN 11167 4486).Applicant amended independent claim 1 to include the allowable subject matter in original claim 3, and respectfully submits that amended claim 1 and its dependent claims are patentable. Independent claim 20 is amended to recite similar features as the amended claim 1. For similar reasons as amended claim 1, amended independent claim 20 is patentable.Withdrawal of the rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 103 is therefore respectfully requested.III. Allowable Subject Matter Applicant notes with appreciation that claims 3, 9-10, and 13-14 have been indicated to contain allowable subject matter.IV. Conclusion In view of the amendments to the claims and the foregoing remarks, Applicant submits that the pending claims are in condition for allowance. Reconsideration is therefore respectfully requested. The Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney for the Applicant via telephone if such communication would expedite this application.April 7, 2025 Respectfully submitted, /Hefeng Su/ Hefeng Su Registration No. L1283 CROWELL & MORING LLPIntellectual Property Group P.O.
